description: La Niçoise in Paris – A unique place, full of charm, a house with veranda and garden, exclusively dedicated to your professional events. For your seminars, cocktails, shoots, filming, product launches or meetings, offer your guests a rare break:a house with garden in the middle of Paris, a stone's throw from the Coulée Verte.Elegantly decorated, between living room with garden view, large bright veranda and living area with open kitchen.During the day and until midnight.
